rules.within_group: descending best_dip_contrast for dip lanes; fold_best_z for fold lanes; max_bright_contrast for brightening; numeric TIC tie-break

limits: Scheduling heuristic informed by the same reviewed100, not held-out validation.
Group evidence supports cross/multi before other lanes; order among remaining four lanes is operational, not measured superiority.
Maximum contrast is not statistical significance; selection trials and observation counts vary.
Flags across sectors do not establish same-kind recurrence; quality of raw events and source attribution require review.
Fold coverage is restricted to a selected subset; missing flag/attempt is not a negative test.
No Gaia period agreement, slope, common-mode, brightness, or depth veto.
No physical classification, novelty clearance, ledger changes or new R IDs.
